verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs say Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides managed LDAP and Kerberos/NTLM authentication, built for legacy apps that can't use modern authentication. That covers the cloud-LDAP half of the story, though through a companion Entra service rather than Entra ID itself. Nothing in the evidence shows a RADIUS endpoint for VPNs or Wi-Fi; the VPN-less remote access claim is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: any RADIUS endpoint for VPN/Wi-Fi authentication, depth on LDAP configuration and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
